name: EU and EEA free movement
note: Directive 2004/38/EC, extended to Iceland, Liechtenstein and Norway by the EEA Agreement. Beyond three months a registration is usually required, but no visa or permit to work.

name: Swiss-EU free movement
note: The EU-Swiss Agreement on the Free Movement of Persons (and the EFTA Convention). Swiss citizens have the same right in the EU and EEA.

name: Common Travel Area
note: British and Irish citizens may live and work in each other's country (UK-Ireland Memorandum of Understanding, 2019).

name: Trans-Tasman Travel Arrangement
note: Australian and New Zealand citizens may live and work in each other's country.
